heading: `no` (negation)
text:
### `no` (negation) [RLOW.5.3]

A negated pattern compiles to a NOT (negative) beta node
over the pattern's alpha node, carrying the same alpha and
join tests as the positive form ([IRET.7.9]):
the token passes only when no matching fact exists.

idris.name: rlow_5_3__negs_from
idris.note: Each NOT node as a blocker over its positive prefix, with the same alpha and join tests as the positive form.

idris.name: rlow_5_3__facts
idris.note: The facts each lowered blocker reads: those of its alpha's kind.

idris.name: rlow_5_3__tests
idris.note: Each NOT node's test over its positive prefix, as the lowering lists them.

idris.name: Rlow_5_3__same_negs
idris.note: Two blocker lists that read the same kinds and decide alike.

idris.name: rlow_5_3__negs_from_node
idris.note: One NOT node lowers to the same blocker under alphas of one shape, given the rest at every position.

idris.name: rlow_5_3__negs_from_same
idris.note: The blockers a chain lowers to are the same under alphas of one shape.
